title: initialUiState doesn't work with routing
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
initialUiState setting doesn't work if there is routing setting (not the simple "routing: true" but with seo-friendly urls settings).

**To Reproduce 🔍**
As you can see from the live demo initialUiState query = 'stick' is not  working, if you comment line 31 "routing: searchRouting," initialUiState will works.
Live demo: https://codesandbox.io/s/flamboyant-cache-l6ne6?file=/src/app.js

**Expected behavior 💭**
initialUiState works with routing enabled

**Environment:**

* OS: mac
* Browser chrome
* Version 81
